_about: Shared tables brief §3: people tables per culture and period (historic AN, MD, EM; modern ST, MO). Names are real, attested and in their usual English spelling, ordered and weighted by how common they were. A third element marks a name kept mainly for a royal (r) or saintly (s) bearer: no more than a fifth of a given-name or surname list. All 30 cultures (8 core, 22 second tier); local cultures resolve to the nearest through `resolve`.

nearFuture._about: NF and IS draw from the culture's own `modern` list, with this share of names from the other cultures' `modern` lists, each weighted by family.

tokens.g: a given name (male or female by the slot's sexShare)
tokens.s: a surname; where a period has none, the slot falls back to {g}
tokens.r: a ruler form filled with a regnal name
tokens.h: a holy form filled with a holy name

officialTitles.from: the titles module's office kind, in the culture's bynames culture (src/data/bynames.json: `officeWord` and `ranks`)

extras._about: A short set added to a culture's lists when a local culture reads it (the Ottoman, Turkish names beside the Arabic and Persian). Weight 5 each; no surnames (Turkish surnames date from 1934).
